reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 3 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Lakers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 55 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 206 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: The Lakers blew a 16-point halftime lead in San Antonio and are out of the Cup. Luka Doncic is 13-of-64 from three over his last five games and had a postgame run-in with a fan. Austin Reaves is back. Memphis won their Cup group and are on a three-game win streak, but they are still without Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant. Momentum favours Memphis and the healthier roster favours the Lakers, so the news is roughly neutral.
